rows.rationale: Keeps suffering connected to the evaluative claim without calling suffering itself good.
rows.before: This is evidence of God’s righteous judgment, so that you may be considered worthy of God’s kingdom, for which you are also suffering.
rows.after: This is evidence of God's righteous judgment, so that you may be considered worthy of God's kingdom, for which you also suffer.
rows.tsw_comparator: This is evidence of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be considered worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are also suffering,
rows.exact_source_record: ἔνδειγμα τῆς δικαίας κρίσεως τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ καταξιωθῆναι ὑμᾶς τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ, ὑπὲρ ἧς καὶ πάσχετε,

rows.rationale: Preserves the letter's retributive claim and repeated affliction wording.
rows.before: For it is righteous with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
rows.after: Indeed, it is just for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
rows.tsw_comparator: since indeed it is just for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
rows.exact_source_record: εἴπερ δίκαιον παρὰ θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι τοῖς θλίβουσιν ὑμᾶς θλῖψιν

rows.rationale: Keeps relief, solidarity and the public heavenly revelation.
rows.before: and to give relief to you who are afflicted, along with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his powerful angels
rows.after: and to give relief to you who are afflicted, along with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his powerful angels
rows.tsw_comparator: and to grant relief to you who are afflicted, as well as to us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
rows.exact_source_record: καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς θλιβομένοις ἄνεσιν μεθʼ ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ μετʼ ἀγγέλων δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ

rows.rationale: Retains fire, vengeance/justice and both described groups.
rows.before: in flaming fire, bringing judgment on those who do not know God and those who do not obey the good news of our Lord Jesus.
rows.after: in flaming fire, bringing justice on those who do not know God and who do not obey the good news of our Lord Jesus.
rows.tsw_comparator: in flaming fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and on those who do not obey the good news of our Lord Jesus.
rows.exact_source_record: ἐν ⸂φλογὶ πυρός⸃, διδόντος ἐκδίκησιν τοῖς μὴ εἰδόσι θεὸν καὶ τοῖς μὴ ὑπακούουσιν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ,

rows.rationale: Keeps punishment language and the debated away-from relation without softening duration.
rows.before: They will pay the penalty of eternal destruction away from the Lord’s presence and from the glory of his might,
rows.after: They will pay the penalty of eternal destruction away from the Lord's presence and from the glory of his might,
rows.tsw_comparator: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his power,
rows.exact_source_record: οἵτινες δίκην τίσουσιν ὄλεθρον αἰώνιον ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ,

rows.rationale: Preserves the day's two purposes and the community's response.
rows.before: when he comes on that day to be glorified among his holy ones and marveled at among all who trusted—because our testimony to you was trusted.
rows.after: when he comes on that day to be glorified among his saints and marveled at among all who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
rows.tsw_comparator: when he comes on that day to be glorified in his holy ones and to be marveled at among all who have believed—because our testimony to you was believed.
rows.exact_source_record: ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐνδοξασθῆναι ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ καὶ θαυμασθῆναι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύσασιν, ὅτι ἐπιστεύθη τὸ μαρτύριον ἡμῶν ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς, ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ.

rows.rationale: Preserves three alleged channels, false attribution and the pinned day title.
rows.before: not to be quickly shaken from your mind or alarmed, whether by a spirit, a spoken message, or a letter supposedly from us, claiming that the Lord’s day has arrived.
rows.after: not to be quickly shaken from your senses or alarmed, whether by a spirit, a spoken message or a letter supposedly from us, claiming that the day of the Lord has already arrived.
rows.tsw_comparator: not to be quickly shaken in mind or alarmed, either by a spirit or a word or a letter as though from us, to the effect that the day of the Lord has come.
rows.exact_source_record: εἰς τὸ μὴ ταχέως σαλευθῆναι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ νοὸς ⸀μηδὲ θροεῖσθαι μήτε διὰ πνεύματος μήτε διὰ λόγου μήτε διʼ ἐπιστολῆς ὡς διʼ ἡμῶν, ὡς ὅτι ἐνέστηκεν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ ⸀κυρίου.

rows.rationale: Retains the supplied future logic, rebellion and pinned lawlessness reading.
rows.before: Let no one deceive you in any way. For that day will not come unless the rebellion comes first and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction,
rows.after: Do not let anyone deceive you in any way. That day will not come unless the rebellion comes first and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction.
rows.tsw_comparator: Let no one deceive you in any way; for that day will not come unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction,

rows.rationale: Keeps sweeping self-exaltation, temple action and blasphemous claim.
rows.before: who opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he seats himself in God’s temple, presenting himself as God.
rows.after: He opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he seats himself in God's temple, presenting himself as God.
rows.tsw_comparator: who opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he takes his seat in the temple of God, declaring himself to be God.
rows.exact_source_record: ὁ ἀντικείμενος καὶ ὑπεραιρόμενος ἐπὶ πάντα λεγόμενον θεὸν ἢ σέβασμα, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ καθίσαι ἀποδεικνύντα ἑαυτὸν ὅτι ἔστιν θεός.

rows.rationale: Keeps the restrainer unnamed and the timing purpose.
rows.before: And now you know what restrains him so that he may be revealed in his own time.
rows.after: And now you know what restrains him, so that he may be revealed at his own time.
rows.tsw_comparator: And now you know what restrains him, so that he may be revealed in his time.
rows.exact_source_record: καὶ νῦν τὸ κατέχον οἴδατε, εἰς τὸ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ⸀ἑαυτοῦ καιρῷ·

rows.rationale: Retains the shift from neuter restraint to a personal restrainer without identifying either.
rows.before: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the one who now restrains it will do so until he is out of the way.
rows.after: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the one now restraining it will continue until he is out of the way.
rows.tsw_comparator: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the one who now restrains it will do so until he is taken out of the way.
rows.exact_source_record: τὸ γὰρ μυστήριον ἤδη ἐνεργεῖται τῆς ἀνομίας· μόνον ὁ κατέχων ἄρτι ἕως ἐκ μέσου γένηται.

rows.rationale: Keeps lethal judgment, breath image and doubled manifestation language.
rows.before: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will destroy with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming.
rows.after: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will kill with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming.
rows.tsw_comparator: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will kill with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming.
rows.exact_source_record: καὶ τότε ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ὁ ἄνομος, ὃν ὁ κύριος ⸀Ἰησοῦς ⸀ἀνελεῖ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ καταργήσει τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ,

rows.rationale: Preserves the parallel coming and counterfeit power triad.
rows.before: The lawless one’s coming is according to Satan’s working, with every kind of power, false signs and wonders,
rows.after: The lawless one's coming is in accordance with Satan's activity, with every kind of power, false signs and wonders,
rows.tsw_comparator: The coming of the lawless one is by the activity of Satan with all power and signs and false wonders,
rows.exact_source_record: οὗ ἐστιν ἡ παρουσία κατʼ ἐνέργειαν τοῦ Σατανᾶ ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει καὶ σημείοις καὶ τέρασιν ψεύδους

rows.rationale: Retains divine agency in the difficult judgment claim.
rows.before: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion so that they trust the lie,
rows.after: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion, so that they believe the lie,
rows.tsw_comparator: And for this reason God sends them a working of delusion so that they may believe what is false,
rows.exact_source_record: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ⸀πέμπει αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς ἐνέργειαν πλάνης εἰς τὸ πιστεῦσαι αὐτοὺς τῷ ψεύδει,

rows.rationale: Keeps both disbelief and moral delight as grounds.
rows.before: so that all may be judged who did not trust the truth but delighted in unrighteousness.
rows.after: so that all who did not believe the truth but delighted in unrighteousness may be judged.
rows.tsw_comparator: in order that all may be judged who did not believe the truth but took pleasure in unrighteousness.
rows.exact_source_record: ἵνα κριθῶσιν ⸀πάντες οἱ μὴ πιστεύσαντες τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ἀλλὰ εὐδοκήσαντες ⸀τῇ ἀδικίᾳ.

rows.rationale: Follows the pinned firstfruits reading and retains both means.
rows.before: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits for salvation through holiness by the Spirit and trust in the truth.
rows.after: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits for salvation through the Spirit's sanctifying work and faith in the truth.
rows.tsw_comparator: But we ought always to give thanks to God for you, brothers and sisters beloved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification by the Spirit and belief in the truth,
rows.exact_source_record: Ἡμεῖς δὲ ὀφείλομεν εὐχαριστεῖν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ κυρίου, ὅτι εἵλατο ὑμᾶς ὁ θεὸς ⸀ἀπαρχὴν εἰς σωτηρίαν ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος καὶ πίστει ἀληθείας,

rows.rationale: Preserves stability, transmitted teaching and both media.
rows.before: Therefore, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold to the traditions you were taught, whether by our spoken word or by our letter.
rows.after: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the traditions you were taught, whether by our spoken word or by our letter.
rows.tsw_comparator: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the traditions that you were taught, whether by word or by our letter.
rows.exact_source_record: ἄρα οὖν, ἀδελφοί, στήκετε, καὶ κρατεῖτε τὰς παραδόσεις ἃς ἐδιδάχθητε εἴτε διὰ λόγου εἴτε διʼ ἐπιστολῆς ἡμῶν.

rows.rationale: Keeps the compound subject and the two grace-gifts.
rows.before: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal encouragement and good hope by grace,
rows.after: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope,
rows.tsw_comparator: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

rows.rationale: Preserves the contrast, stability and personal/impersonal ambiguity of evil.
rows.before: But the Lord is faithful. He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
rows.after: But the Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
rows.tsw_comparator: But the Lord is faithful, who will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
rows.exact_source_record: πιστὸς δέ ἐστιν ὁ κύριος, ὃς στηρίξει ὑμᾶς καὶ φυλάξει ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ.

rows.rationale: Retains two ambiguous genitives rather than resolving whose love or endurance.
rows.before: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s endurance.
rows.after: May the Lord direct your hearts into God's love and Christ's endurance.
rows.tsw_comparator: May the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the steadfastness of Christ.
rows.exact_source_record: ὁ δὲ κύριος κατευθύναι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας εἰς τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἰς τὴν ὑπομονὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

rows.rationale: Keeps strong authority, communal distance and the conduct standard.
rows.before: We command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from every brother or sister who lives disorderly and not according to the tradition they received from us.
rows.after: Now we command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from every brother or sister who lives disorderly and not according to the tradition received from us.
rows.tsw_comparator: Now we command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you keep away from every brother or sister walking disorderly and not according to the tradition that you received from us.
rows.exact_source_record: Παραγγέλλομεν δὲ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου ⸀ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ στέλλεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ παντὸς ἀδελφοῦ ἀτάκτως περιπατοῦντος καὶ μὴ κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ἣν ⸀παρελάβοσαν παρʼ ἡμῶν.

rows.rationale: Preserves unwillingness rather than inability and the quoted command.
rows.before: For even when we were with you, we gave you this command: if anyone is not willing to work, that person should not eat.
rows.after: Even when we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, that person should not eat.”
rows.tsw_comparator: For even when we were with you, we gave you this command: if anyone is not willing to work, neither let him eat.
rows.exact_source_record: καὶ γὰρ ὅτε ἦμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, τοῦτο παρηγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν, ὅτι εἴ τις οὐ θέλει ἐργάζεσθαι μηδὲ ἐσθιέτω.

rows.rationale: Preserves social discipline and its stated corrective aim.
rows.before: If anyone does not obey our word in this letter, take note of that person and do not associate closely with them, so that they may be ashamed.
rows.after: If anyone does not obey our word in this letter, take note of that person and do not associate closely, so that the person may feel ashamed.
rows.tsw_comparator: And if anyone does not obey what we say in this letter, take note of that person and do not associate with him, so that he may be put to shame.
rows.exact_source_record: Εἰ δέ τις οὐχ ὑπακούει τῷ λόγῳ ἡμῶν διὰ τῆς ἐπιστολῆς, τοῦτον σημειοῦσθε, ⸀μὴ ⸀συναναμίγνυσθαι αὐτῷ, ἵνα ἐντραπῇ·

rows.rationale: Keeps the limit on discipline and familial identity.
rows.before: Yet do not regard that person as an enemy; warn them as a brother or sister.
rows.after: Yet do not regard that person as an enemy, but warn them as a brother or sister.
rows.tsw_comparator: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother or sister.
rows.exact_source_record: καὶ μὴ ὡς ἐχθρὸν ἡγεῖσθε, ἀλλὰ νουθετεῖτε ὡς ἀδελφόν.
